title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard
workpass: 26 — temporal MemoryOS2 semantics, side-effect-free preview and UI inspector controls
method: WorkPass26 closes a scoped implementation deliverable in the canonical MemoryOS2 temporal path: archive retrieval no longer drops expired revisions, absent asOfAt selects the live temporal view rather than epoch zero, and inspector previews operate on an isolated snapshot; Runtime Atlas exposes the temporal controls. This is code-path correctness in deterministic tests, not measured retrieval uplift. An independently labelled temporal holdout and BM25 comparison are still required; UI production build/browser E2E and other release gates remain open.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: No duplicate canonical owner; source manifests and metadata contract reconciled.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass16 makes browser smoke fail closed on required brand warnings and actual auth mismatch, exposes indeterminate auth state, validates bounded timeouts, and atomically publishes private verdict files. The 212/212 source-only UI script suite passes; dependency-complete UI build and actual browser E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass26 repairs temporal archive filtering and absent/null asOfAt semantics, adds an isolated-snapshot read-only preview across MemoryOS2→MemoryFabric→OrganismCore, and exposes current/as-of/all revision search through Runtime Atlas. Focused regressions pass; this does not prove independent temporal retrieval uplift, which remains not-promoted pending labelled holdout and BM25 comparison.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass20 adds exact action execution/step receipt correlation and a persisted bounded idempotency ledger; duplicate/stale receipts cannot advance later project steps. Entire action→independent external receipt→reafference chain remains partial.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass25 supplies a deterministic private-first temperature-scaling fitter with a group-disjoint validation fold, version/dataset-bound artifact contract, NLL/Brier/ECE eligibility thresholds and provenance propagation into evidence/restore. This is an implemented pipeline only: the real pinned pretrained model and independent final holdout have not been run.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Release metadata and operational readiness reporting improved; dependency-complete app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room restore/rollback, soak and final SBOM/provenance remain open.

normalizedTaskInventory.note: Normalized unique deliverables, not append-only historical tasklist line counts. PARTIAL is not treated as DONE. This inventory score does not establish release readiness.

environmentNote: WorkPass25: runtime TypeScript and focused implementation tests pass; all root gate components have passed, though one final concatenated aggregate invocation exceeded the tool time limit after completing the nested runtime gate. Calibration fitter uses a local mock; no real model inference was run because model/package registry DNS remains unavailable. UI production build is blocked by missing Vite install. Memory candidate remains not-promoted because its confidence interval permits regression and an independent temporal holdout is still absent.
limitations: Actual pinned DeBERTa model weights and inference were not run in this environment; package/model registry DNS was unavailable. Calibration fitter tests use a loopback mock, not real inference.

Temperature fit uses its own training subset; NLL/Brier/ECE review checks are calculated on a deterministic group-disjoint validation subset from a dedicated calibration set. The final evaluation holdout must remain separate and untouched.
Temperature scaling calibrates NLI class scores for the represented distribution. It does not turn NLI into a probability that a sourced world claim is true and is never auto-promoted.
The test suite verifies contracts, group-disjoint split and provenance/failure handling but does not establish domain quality, multilingual behavior or improvement over baseline.
MemoryOS2 benchmark candidate remains not-promoted: a confidence interval allows regression, and an independent labelled temporal holdout and BM25 comparison remain open.
App dependency-complete installation, React/Vite production build and desktop/mobile browser E2E remain open because the sandbox cannot resolve package registries.
Live external research/provider receipts, complete agency→independent postcondition→reafference, clean-room restore/rollback, multi-hour soak, SBOM/provenance and final sign-off remain open.
No release-ready status or human-like/biological intelligence claim is made.
